entries.description: [eq-ctl-differ] `sigmaProp(Coll[T]() == Coll[U]())`. `T` and `U` differ: REJECTED (`ConstraintFailed`, `SameType2`). CONTROL: what a name mismatch does.

entries.name: jdk-utf8-decode-eq-overlong-vs-3ff-v0#8
entries.description: [eq-overlong-vs-3ff] `sigmaProp(Coll[⟨E0 80 80⟩]() == Coll[⟨FF FF FF⟩]())`. Both decode to three U+FFFD: the types are EQUAL, the node is built, and both names are written `EF BF BD × 3`. SEPARATING: a port that compares the bytes, or replaces the overlong once, refuses the tree.
